method: I parsed each engine file with acorn (from tools/node_modules), using the checkout at scratchpad/r7. From the Program body I took every FunctionDeclaration, ClassDeclaration and VariableDeclaration, and counted each declarator name, including destructured names, as one declaration. That gives core 138, game 714 and editor 353. For comparison, the grep in the brief finds 126, 513 and 255 column-0 declaration lines, because many lines declare several names. A declaration counts as covered when a row's Where names it as a whole identifier (I ran a regex over every row's Where, the PG rows that point at engine files included), or when a cited line or range contains it and the row's system plausibly owns it. I dropped three name hits that only matched prose (buildings, kills, enemies). Line-only hits I checked by hand, and some were rejected: in game, 21 hits not owned by the citing row, for example GW5's '24-220' slider clamp, which the matcher read as a line range. In editor, 6 were rejected: ED5's ':50' is the prose '50 steps', and CD2's 696-708 range belongs to KVStore, not to the editor's modal handles. Accepted ranges include ED1 18-45, ED2 115-123 and 163-167, ED5 240-261 and 297-299, ED7 322, ED8 477-492, ED4 647-653, GE1 785-796, ED10 801-843 and ED11 844. Result: core 138/138, game 584/714, editor 204/353, overall 926/1205. One line error found: CL12 puts GUN_WORDS at game:46 and KILL_WORDS at :47, but the code has them at :45 and :46 (GW3 has it right). Notes are in scratchpad/r7/.checkpoints/r7-legacy-inventory/critic-coverage.md; the scripts are scratchpad/critic/decls.js and match.js, and the results are in decls.json and match.json.
